listings.name: Bank
listings.tagline: A second brain your wrapps can borrow from.

tools.name: bank_ask
tools.description: Ask the context bank a question, answered from the user's own notes. Streams the answer onto the page and returns it.

inputSchema.question: string — the question to answer from the vault. Required.

listings.tagline: Your whole brand, one place.

listings.name: AdPulse
listings.tagline: Find the ad spend that's being wasted.
listings.author: Switchboard
inside: A post-mortem on where the budget leaked
Analyze headless across accounts (batch)
Scheduled rollups when you want them

tools.name: adpulse_diagnose
tools.description: Diagnose a Meta Ads Manager export (CSV) — health score, wins, leaks, ranked actions, and per-campaign verdicts. Renders the readout live and returns it.

inputSchema.csv: string — a Meta Ads Manager CSV export. Optional when data is already loaded.

listings.name: Autopilot
listings.tagline: It plans your week and makes the moves.
listings.author: Switchboard
inside: A finite move-engine — no runaway loops
Plan, then run the slate headless (batch)
Every action gated + audited by the daemon

listings.name: Batch
listings.tagline: Run one prompt across a whole list.

tools.name: batch_draft
tools.description: Draft a full YC application (all 8 answers, one recommended each, plus the two video scripts) from a one-line idea. Fills the cards live on the page and returns the drafted application as markdown; nothing is locked or submitted.

inputSchema.idea: string — one line on what you're building. Required.

listings.name: Redline
listings.tagline: Mark up a landing page like a doc.
listings.author: Switchboard
inside: A line-by-line review of any page or doc
Audit and respond as two headless workflows (batch)
Its own taste.md so the notes sound like you

listings.name: A-Plus
listings.tagline: Amazon A+ content, in bulk.

tools.name: aplus_write
tools.description: Write a full Amazon A+ content stack for a product (a line or a product-page URL). Renders it live on the page and returns it.

inputSchema.product: string — the product to write A+ content for. Optional when a brand is lent.

listings.name: AdForge
listings.tagline: Draft this week's ads from your brand.

tools.name: adforge_run
tools.description: Forge three Meta ad concepts from a site URL (or the lent brand). Renders them live on the page and returns them.

inputSchema.url: string — a site to forge ads from. Optional when a brand is lent.

listings.name: Adwall
listings.tagline: A wall of ad variations at once.

tools.name: adgen_run
tools.description: Draft a wall of six ad directions from a site URL (or the lent brand). Renders them live on the page and returns them.

inputSchema.url: string — a site to draft ad directions from. Optional when a brand is lent.

listings.name: Canvas
listings.tagline: Describe it — get an editable diagram or board.

tools.name: canvas_run
tools.description: Describe a diagram, board, or layout in words and get an editable, self-contained HTML document. Renders it live on the page and returns the document HTML.

inputSchema.prompt: string — one line describing the diagram/board/layout to draw. Required.

listings.name: Cartridge
listings.tagline: Build a little browser game.

tools.name: cartridge_run
tools.description: Forge a complete, self-contained HTML5 game from one idea. Generates it live on the page and returns the game's title.

inputSchema.idea: string — one line describing the game to make. Required.

tools.name: cut_run
tools.description: Turn a video transcript (or rough notes) into a cut plan: on-screen captions + a highlight cut list (keep MM:SS–MM:SS with a reason) + what to trim. Writes it live on the page and returns it.

inputSchema.transcript: string — the video transcript or rough notes to plan a cut from. Required.

listings.tagline: Get everyone on the same call, fast.

tools.name: huddle_ask
tools.description: Say something on the working call with Claude. Streams the reply into the transcript (and speaks it on-device), then returns the reply text.

inputSchema.message: string — what to say to the call. Required.

listings.name: Identity
listings.tagline: A visual identity from a few words.

tools.name: identity_compose
tools.description: Compose an AI creator persona (person, voice, look, audience, pillars — one recommended each) from a one-line brief. Fills the cards live on the page and returns the drafted persona; it does not publish it to Cast.

inputSchema.brief: string — one line describing the creator (niche, vibe, who they're for). Required.

listings.name: Marketplace Validator
listings.tagline: Is this marketplace worth building? Find out.

listings.name: Marquee
listings.tagline: A landing page that ships to a domain.

tools.name: marquee_build
tools.description: Build a cinematic scrolling landing page from one line: writes a complete self-contained HTML page into the live preview and paints its hero on your Higgsfield. Returns the page HTML.

inputSchema.brief: string — one line on what the landing page is for. Required.

listings.name: Meeting Notes
listings.tagline: Paste a transcript — get notes + action items.

tools.name: meetnotes_run
tools.description: Turn a meeting transcript or rough notes into clean structured notes (TL;DR, decisions, action items with owners/dues, open questions). Writes it live on the page and returns it.

inputSchema.transcript: string — the meeting transcript or rough notes to structure. Required.

listings.name: Prism
listings.tagline: Generate on-brand images from a prompt.

tools.name: imagegen_generate
tools.description: Generate an image from a text prompt on your Higgsfield. Renders it live on the page and returns the image URL. Optionally guided by a reference image.

inputSchema.prompt: string — what to generate (subject, setting, lighting…). Required.
inputSchema.reference: string — OPTIONAL. A data: URL of a reference image to guide the render (image-to-image).

listings.name: Reel
listings.tagline: Short-form video from a brand kit.

tools.name: reel_generate
tools.description: Draft a promo/launch reel from one line: writes a 4–6 scene script and paints each scene on your Higgsfield, live on the page. Returns the scenes (title, subtitle, image URL); it does not render the final video.

inputSchema.brief: string — one line on what the reel is for. Required.

listings.name: Retail Concept
listings.tagline: Reality-check a retail concept.

listings.name: SaaS Thesis
listings.tagline: Turn a SaaS hunch into a thesis.

listings.name: Shelf
listings.tagline: Keep inventory honest.

tools.name: shelf_triage
tools.description: Triage an inventory sheet (CSV of stock + sales) into reorder / watch / dead-weight, ABC, and one-week plans. Renders the board live and returns it.

inputSchema.sheet: string — CSV of stock + sales. Optional when a brand's inventory is lent (or the demo is used).

listings.name: Studio
listings.tagline: Product photography on your own models.

tools.name: studio_shoot
tools.description: Shoot one product photo on your Higgsfield from a product description. Develops it into the contact sheet and returns the image URL.

inputSchema.product: string — the product to shoot (one line). Required.

listings.name: Take
listings.tagline: One take, many cuts.

tools.name: take_script
tools.description: Draft a recording script (beats for a screen or camera take) from a line describing what you're recording. Renders on the page and returns the recommended script; it does not start a recording.

inputSchema.about: string — what you're recording (e.g. 'a 40-second walkthrough of the pricing page'). Required.

listings.name: Action Items
listings.tagline: Notes or a transcript into a clean checklist.

tools.name: actions_run
tools.description: Turn meeting notes or a transcript into a clean action-item checklist (owners and due dates where implied). Writes it live on the page and returns it.

inputSchema.notes: string — the notes or transcript to extract action items from. Required.

listings.name: Caption
listings.tagline: Social captions with hashtags — five options, one pick

tools.name: caption_run
tools.description: Write 5 social captions plus a hashtag set for a post, one marked recommended. Writes them live on the page and returns them.

inputSchema.about: string — what the post or photo is. Required.

listings.name: Clip Doctor
listings.tagline: Clean up pasted text — quotes, breaks, tracking junk

tools.name: clipfix_run
tools.description: Clean pasted text: fix smart-quotes, unwrap hard line breaks, strip tracking params from URLs, tidy whitespace. Writes the cleaned text live on the page and returns it.

inputSchema.text: string — the pasted text to clean. Required.

listings.name: Cold Email
listings.tagline: A target and an ask into a short, non-cringe cold email

tools.name: coldemail_run
tools.description: Write a short, non-cringe cold email (subject + body + one clear ask) from a target and an ask. Writes it live on the page and returns it.

inputSchema.brief: string — who you're emailing and the ask. Required.

listings.name: Commit
listings.tagline: A diff into a Conventional Commits message

tools.name: commit_run
tools.description: Write a Conventional Commits message (typed subject + body bullets) from a diff or change summary. Writes it live on the page and returns it.

inputSchema.diff: string — the diff or change summary to describe. Required.

listings.name: Compare
listings.tagline: Options side by side, pros/cons, one pick

tools.name: compare_run
tools.description: Compare options side by side (pros/cons per option) with one recommendation. Writes the comparison live on the page and returns it.

inputSchema.items: string — the options to compare (e.g. 'A vs B vs C for X'). Required.

listings.name: Convert
listings.tagline: Data between JSON, CSV, YAML, and Markdown tables

tools.name: convert_run
tools.description: Convert data between JSON/CSV/YAML/Markdown table — infers the source, outputs the most useful target (a Markdown table if ambiguous). Writes it live on the page and returns it.

inputSchema.data: string — the structured data to convert. Required.

listings.name: Cron
listings.tagline: A schedule into a cron expression, and back to English

tools.name: cron_run
tools.description: Convert a plain-English schedule to a cron expression (with a human-readable confirmation), or explain a cron expression field by field. Writes it live on the page and returns it.

inputSchema.schedule: string — a schedule to convert, or a cron expression to explain. Required.

listings.name: Docstring
listings.tagline: A function into a clear docstring/JSDoc with an example

tools.name: docstring_run
tools.description: Write a clear docstring/JSDoc for a function — params, returns, one example — in the language's own convention. Writes it live on the page and returns it.

inputSchema.code: string — the function source to document. Required.

listings.name: Errslate
listings.tagline: Decode any error or stack trace: meaning, cause, fix

tools.name: errslate_run
tools.description: Decode an error message or stack trace: what it means, the likely cause, and the fix. Writes it live on the page and returns it.

inputSchema.error: string — the error message or stack trace to decode. Required.

listings.name: Explain This
listings.tagline: Turn confusing text into plain English.

tools.name: explainthis_run
tools.description: Explain a bit of text in plain English for a smart non-expert. Writes it live on the page and returns it.

inputSchema.text: string — the text to explain. Required.

listings.name: Extract
listings.tagline: Pull key fields into a clean labeled list.

tools.name: extract_run
tools.description: Pull the key fields and entities out of a bit of text into a clean labeled list. Writes it live on the page and returns it.

inputSchema.text: string — the text to extract fields from. Required.

listings.name: Formula
listings.tagline: Plain English into the exact spreadsheet formula

tools.name: formula_run
tools.description: Write the exact spreadsheet formula for a plain-English need (Google Sheets + Excel), with one line explaining it. Writes it live on the page and returns it.

inputSchema.need: string — the spreadsheet need in plain English. Required.

listings.name: Gist
listings.tagline: Paste anything, get a tight TL;DR.

tools.name: gist_run
tools.description: Summarize a bit of text into a tight TL;DR (2 sentences + up to 4 bullets). Writes it live on the page and returns it.

inputSchema.text: string — the text to summarize. Required.

listings.name: Hooks
listings.tagline: Scroll-stopping opening lines for posts, videos, and emails

tools.name: hooks_run
tools.description: Write 7 scroll-stopping opening lines (hooks) for a topic, one marked recommended. Writes them live on the page and returns them.

inputSchema.topic: string — what the post/video/email is about. Required.

listings.name: Name It
listings.tagline: Six strong name options, each with a rationale.

tools.name: nameit_run
tools.description: Propose six strong name options (each with a rationale) for a described product, company, feature, or project. Writes them live on the page and returns them.

inputSchema.description: string — a description of the thing to name. Required.

listings.name: Objection
listings.tagline: A sales or investor objection into a calm, honest response

tools.name: objection_run
tools.description: Reframe a sales or investor objection and draft a calm, honest response plus a one-liner. Writes it live on the page and returns it.

inputSchema.objection: string — the objection you're facing. Required.

listings.name: Outline
listings.tagline: A clean structure for a post, talk, or doc

tools.name: outline_run
tools.description: Produce a clean hierarchical outline for a post, talk, or doc, with a suggested hook and CTA. Writes it live on the page and returns it.

inputSchema.topic: string — what you're writing or presenting. Required.

listings.name: Polish
listings.tagline: Proofread and clarify — your voice intact.

tools.name: polish_run
tools.description: Proofread and clarify a bit of text while keeping the author's voice. Writes it live on the page and returns it.

inputSchema.text: string — the text to polish. Required.

listings.name: Recap
listings.tagline: Long doc into TL;DR, key points, decisions, next steps.

tools.name: recap_run
tools.description: Summarize a long doc or thread into a structured recap (TL;DR, key points, decisions, next steps). Writes it live on the page and returns it.

inputSchema.document: string — the long document or thread to recap. Required.

listings.name: Regex
listings.tagline: A matching need into a regular expression, with test cases

tools.name: regex_run
tools.description: Write a regular expression for a plain-English matching need, with 3 matching + 3 non-matching test cases and a brief breakdown. Writes it live on the page and returns it.

inputSchema.need: string — describe what you need to match (and what you don't). Required.

listings.name: Rephrase
listings.tagline: Rewrite text in any tone — meaning kept.

tools.name: rephrase_run
tools.description: Rewrite a bit of text in a requested tone/length, keeping its meaning. Writes it live on the page and returns it.

inputSchema.text: string — the text to rewrite. Required.

listings.name: Reply
listings.tagline: Three replies to any message — concise, warm, firm.

tools.name: reply_run
tools.description: Draft reply options (concise, warm, firm) to a message or thread. Writes them live on the page and returns them.

inputSchema.message: string — the message or thread to reply to. Required.

listings.name: Repurpose
listings.tagline: One piece of content, tuned for every channel

tools.name: repurpose_run
tools.description: Rewrite one piece of content into an X thread, a LinkedIn post, an Instagram caption, and a short-form video script. Writes them live on the page and returns them.

inputSchema.content: string — the content to repurpose. Required.

listings.name: Shell
listings.tagline: A task into the exact shell command, every flag explained

tools.name: shell_run
tools.description: Give the exact shell command(s) for a task, with each flag explained — and a warning above anything destructive. Writes it live on the page and returns it.

inputSchema.task: string — describe the task you want a shell command for. Required.

listings.name: Snap Answer
listings.tagline: One question, one direct answer — no chat thread.

tools.name: snap_run
tools.description: Answer a question directly and concisely on the user's own Claude. Writes the answer live on the page and returns it.

inputSchema.question: string — the question to answer. Required.

listings.name: Spellout
listings.tagline: A rough phrase into a clear line

tools.name: spellout_run
tools.description: Expand a rough phrase or shorthand into a clear, well-formed sentence or short paragraph, keeping the meaning and voice. Writes it live on the page and returns it.

inputSchema.phrase: string — the rough phrase to spell out. Required.

listings.name: Standup
listings.tagline: Notes or commits into a crisp standup update

tools.name: standup_run
tools.description: Turn raw notes or commits into a crisp Yesterday / Today / Blockers standup. Writes it live on the page and returns it.

inputSchema.notes: string — your raw notes, commits, or bullets. Required.

listings.name: Steps
listings.tagline: Name a goal, get a few step-by-step plans

tools.name: steps_run
tools.description: Turn a goal into a few distinct step-by-step plans, each a numbered checklist. Writes them live on the page and returns them.

inputSchema.goal: string — the goal to turn into steps. Required.

listings.name: Titles
listings.tagline: Headline and title options you can A/B

tools.name: titles_run
tools.description: Write 8 headline/title options for a topic across styles, one marked recommended. Writes them live on the page and returns them.

inputSchema.topic: string — what the piece is about. Required.

listings.name: Translate
listings.tagline: Translate any text, tone preserved.

tools.name: translate_run
tools.description: Translate a bit of text into a target language, preserving tone. Writes it live on the page and returns it.

inputSchema.text: string — the text to translate. Required.

listings.name: Unjargon
listings.tagline: Acronyms, legalese, and jargon into plain English.

tools.name: unjargon_run
tools.description: Decode dense text (acronyms, legalese, jargon) into plain English. Writes it live on the page and returns it.

inputSchema.text: string — the dense text to decode. Required.

listings.name: YC Application
listings.tagline: Write YC answers in the house dialect.
listings.author: Switchboard
inside: The YC register + live RFS hooks, worn as a skill
Answer conversationally — God wears the dialect
Or open the composer to draft in a page

listings.name: Arcana
listings.tagline: A tarot pull with a real read.

tools.name: arcana_run
tools.description: Deal a fresh three-card tarot spread for a question and read it live on the page. Returns the drawn cards and the reading.

inputSchema.question: string — the question to read for. Optional; a default is used if omitted.

listings.name: NATAL
listings.tagline: Your chart, read plainly.

tools.name: natal_run
tools.description: Read a natal / birth chart from birth data. Renders the chart on the page and returns it.

inputSchema.date: string — date of birth, YYYY-MM-DD. Required.
inputSchema.place: string — birthplace (city, country) — the rising depends on it. Required.
inputSchema.time: string — time of birth, HH:MM (24h). Optional; omit if unknown.
inputSchema.name: string — the person's name. Optional.
